limitations: The 2014b map is the available training-period vintage; this does not establish that it represents historical annual fuel succession for every event.
Native CFSDS pixels and the 100 m Cell2Fire policy cells have different spatial supports; both are reported rather than treated as interchangeable.
CFSDS day-of-burning is a satellite-hotspot interpolation and not hourly ground truth.
Suppression status remains unknown for every candidate; a fuel-pass does not imply an unsuppressed event or a complete simulator case.
The combined crop-screen JSON contains all splits and was loaded to select train rows; no validation/test fuel or source rasters were opened, and no validation/test candidate received a fuel overlay.
No simulator replay was run, and no model parameters were calibrated.

categories.ambiguous: Vegetated Non-fuel/Unknown or simulator grid code 105
categories.burnable: mapped FBP class supported by the pinned Cell2Fire lookup table
categories.nonfuel: source label Non-fuel/Wetland/Urban or simulator grid code 101
categories.unmapped: no-data, unrecognised source class, or missing map coverage
categories.water: source label Water or simulator grid code 102

method.fractional_rule: Sub-50% observed coverage on excluded fuel is reported in hectares and marked review; it is not silently rounded into a pass.
method.fuel_qc_reference: Bennett et al. 2026, W.I.S.E. assessment; https://doi.org/10.1071/WF26072

fuel_status_meaning.ERROR: source data or processing check failed; candidate is retained with error detail
fuel_status_meaning.FAIL_FUEL_OVERLAP: at least one native fire pixel or model-majority state/target cell overlaps excluded/unmapped fuel
fuel_status_meaning.PASS_FUEL_ONLY: no native-pixel or model-majority overlap with excluded/unmapped fuel; not a full-case pass
fuel_status_meaning.REVIEW_SUBCELL_FUEL_OVERLAP: no majority-cell failure, but fractional model-grid fire coverage overlaps excluded/unmapped fuel

method.model_rule: The same masks are area-averaged to the centered 20x20, 100 m model grid; the 2014b categorical map is nearest-neighbour resampled, matching build_cfsds_case.py. Initial-state and target majority cells on non-burnable/ambiguous/unmapped classes fail the fuel gate.
method.native_rule: CFSDS day n-1 scar/front and day n target are reconstructed from day-of-burning values, then compared against 2014b fuel classes resampled nearest-neighbour to the native 90 m crop.
method.published_filter_inspiration: Bennett et al. report filtering burned-pixel overlap with water/non-fuel and ambiguous FBP classes; this project implements a separate, stricter project-specific train gate and does not claim to reproduce W.I.S.E.

purpose: strict train-only fuel compatibility screen before additional simulator cases or any calibration

summary.reason_full_replay_gate_remains_open: This audit checks fuel only; suppression, terrain, weather/FWI, crop extent, and no-action behavior remain separate gates.
